propositions: Operators need visibility into plan-material-pin drift, enforcement posture, and review-phase compatibility in detailed review evidence (CLI show, MCP detail, audit, close errors, web UI) without surfacing warnings in ordinary ticket lists or persisted events.

All detailed renderers must consume the DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract and display canonical related tickets with pinned/current fingerprint status, missing-target state, enforcement effect, and phase metadata—using only derived status strings, never independent recreations.
Pin enforcement-disabled drift must be labeled as advisory and clearly distinguished from legacy-unpinned relationships, while ordinary list output and stored ticket events remain unchanged.

Audit rendering must call compute_validity with available attestation and caught errors (missing data, timeout, exception) must be logged and rendered as explicitly labeled unavailable without silently altering close-error validity gates.
